foes.name: Test Golem
features: Assembled from spare parts and good intentions
tactics: Appear in the Foe picker only while the Sample extension is enabled
Show its bundled portrait when selected
foes.description: A construct that exists solely to demonstrate that an extension's foes — with their own bundled portrait shipped in extensions/sample/foes/images/ — load, merge, and filter through the catalogue like any base foe.
